events.title: BLOODSTATE Demo Update #4 - THE IMMERSION, COMBAT AND INFECTED OVERHAUL
events.summary: BLOODSTATE — THE IMMERSION, COMBAT AND INFECTED OVERHAUL Thank you to everyone who continues to play the BLOODSTATE demo, report problems and share feedback. This is our largest update so far. Rather than concentrating on a single feature, this update changes how the entire game feels—from the way weapons handle and wounds are presented to how the infected hear, search, pursue and overwhelm the player. events.title: BLOODSTATE Demo Update #3 – Performance, AI & Combat Improvements
events.summary: BLOODSTATE — PERFORMANCE, AI AND COMBAT UPDATE Thank you to everyone continuing to play the BLOODSTATE demo and share feedback. This update contains a broad range of improvements across performance, loading, enemy spawning, zombie behaviour, animation, audio, controls, weapon handling, damage reactions, ragdolls and corpse cleanup.
